Social Emotional

For years, the National Education Association, the National PTA, and other experts have been actively campaigning for schools to take a more moderate approach to homework for elementary school children.

Their recommendations call for the 10-minute rule: 10 minutes of homework per grade level per night, topping out at about 120 minutes a night for high school seniors, and no homework for kindergarteners.
parts.hypothesis: First graders were doing 28 minutes of homework.
